reviews.text: Great choice

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I want to express my deepest gratitude to Cambiando un Destino (Changing a Destiny) for the care and love they have always shown my babies. 🐾❤️

Yesterday, I took Loki to the emergency room, and we were fortunate enough to have him seen by Dr. Jacobo, whom I want to give special recognition to. He is a wonderful doctor—professional, attentive, and above all, incredibly kind. From the very first moment, he gave Loki all the care he needed: he examined him, performed an ultrasound, and was attentive to every detail to properly assess his condition. As a kitty mom, that brings immense peace of mind. 🥹🐱

I have a very special gratitude for this foundation because they have cared for several of my babies over the years, and I have always found them helpful, caring, and professional. Unfortunately, Amon wasn't so lucky and passed away before we knew it, an experience I still carry in my heart. 💔🌈 But that doesn't erase my gratitude for everything you did for him and for the care you've given my other kitties.

Thank you for existing, for giving so many animals a chance, and for having veterinarians like Dr. Jacobo, who, in addition to practicing his profession, demonstrates empathy and true love for them. 🐾❤️

Thank you, Changing a Destiny, for taking care of my babies and for being there for us during moments that mean so much to those of us who love our animals. 🙏🏻🐱💕
Excellent
The care provided to pets by veterinarians is excellent.
Thank you for helping us with our little black cat. Now we want to adopt another one just like her. Don't worry, it doesn't matter if she's an adult.
To Dr. Martin, thank you for being an excellent doctor, always taking care of my cats.

I adopted my dog ​​at Petco.
They are the foundation that rescues the dogs.
I congratulate them on their great work.
And as for the hospital, they offer excellent care and good prices.
They treated my dog ​​well and the prices are affordable.
Excellent service and very friendly, they welcome and treat your pets very well...
Everything was excellent. Great work. Thank you so much for the excellent service.

100% Recommended
...Today, Good Friday, April 3, 2026, they treated my dog ​​for an ear infection. I went there because his usual vet was closed. The cost was 350 pesos, which I'm very happy with since the average emergency vet visit costs 800-1000 pesos.

The service was excellent! The doctor was very professional and careful with my furry friend! He treated him very well and examined him thoroughly.
Something I want to mention is that while I was there, an ambulance arrived with an injured dog. They told me that the ambulance service isn't for accidents at home, but it is for accidents in public places. I was able to see firsthand how they provide service and care with passion, professionalism, and love. Their contact information for donations or services is available online.
We need to support these kinds of places

This veterinary clinic is one of the most affordable in the area because it's a foundation. The staff is friendly and they've taken great care of my pets.

Something I don't understand is their schedule; they have different information everywhere. Once they wouldn't see me because Maps says they close at 6:30 PM, and it's also on their sign at the entrance, but they actually close at 6:00 PM. I complained about the contradictory information, and they very reluctantly replied that that's what their social media is for. So there you have it.
Very professional and they take great care of the pets. Good prices too.
Excellent service
They are attentive, caring, and gentle with the dogs, especially Dr. Astrid Jiménez. Thank you to everyone there for your work.
Excellent service, highly knowledgeable doctors, and excellent prices.
Good service
Friendly, professional. A great place to care for my pets.

Very bad experiences. From the moment I arrived at the clinic and they wanted me to put my dog ​​on the table covered in the fur and drool of the previous patient, to the fact that I had to take her several times for lung and heart checks before and after the prophylaxis, they told me she was fine, but they didn't take or request an X-ray...it turns out my dog ​​had lung metastases, but I only found out thanks to another hospital, and unfortunately, after the prophylaxis. My dog ​​died a month later. If I had known about her condition, I obviously wouldn't have subjected her to the prophylaxis.
Excellent work, Maria is undoubtedly the best rehabilitation specialist.

Almost three years ago, they killed my kitten there, all because they gave him a higher dose than they should have. And when we went back, they said it was stress and refused to do anything, that it wasn't their problem—zero empathy.
At another vet, they did what they could and said it was poisoning from the high dose they gave him. Sadly, my kitten didn't survive.
If I say I'm full, you see I bring my dog ​​and well, thanks to the great attention, I recognize that they give the best treatment
Excellent service at affordable prices, all staff are empathetic and friendly.
Came in for a health certificate for our dog to travel by plane. First time visit. No wait, excellent service, great price, caring staff, and they help get animals adopted.
Highly recommended. I took my kitten for a vaccination and I loved the way the doctor treated him.
Very warm attention to our pets
Excellent service, always friendly, great prices! 100% recommended
They helped me with a free consultation for a stray dog ​​I rescued. They were very kind and the consultation was very professional. The clients who come there clearly trust them. A great clinic.
Excellent service

I want to share a deeply disheartening experience I had at this veterinary hospital. I understand that the veterinary staff may be exhausted, but I believe that compassion and commitment to animals should take precedence. They refused to treat my dog, who was clearly sick, simply because there were a lot of people and closing time was approaching. Even though their hours were until 6:30 p.m. and I arrived at 5:50 p.m., they told me they could no longer admit us.

It's sad and frustrating to see how, in a moment of need, there wasn't even a shred of empathy. Animals depend on us, and a veterinary hospital should be a place of help and refuge, not one that closes its doors to them when they need it most. I sincerely hope that situations like this will make them reflect.
Overall, they provide good service, including consultations, vaccinations, and surgical procedures. The veterinarians are very attentive.

Excellent service, very affordable prices for the quality of consultations and treatments; the veterinarians are highly trained, and their treatment of the animals is very humane and warm. The reception and security staff are extremely friendly. I wholeheartedly recommend the Cambia un Destino Veterinary Medical Center. Thank you so much for your dedication, love, professionalism, and commitment to the animals in your care.
Good treatment for pets, good service, they open at 9 am, many people arrive with their pets and there is only one doctor, there is no parking

I think the veterinarians are very good. I think the spaying/neutering and vaccination campaigns are great so that more animals have access to these services.

My dogs go to different clinics and feel comfortable with the veterinarians.
Attention
Excellent service, they treat the dogs with so much love and care. The prices are very good. I highly recommend them.
Excellent service and the doctors are highly qualified.

Excellent care from the veterinarians, and affordable prices. I had my kitten operated on here, and thankfully, he recovered without complications. They also provided excellent follow-up care and clear instructions for us and his needs.
Highly recommended!

I've taken my pets here for years and they've always been very well cared for. Plus, part of the fee goes to help other dogs and cats in need. The only thing they might be lacking, and I hope they'll have in the future, is either partnerships or opening their own branch for more specialized studies and consultations, and perhaps rehabilitation for very specific situations. I hope that will be possible someday, so that veterinarians can provide the best possible follow-up care (which, by the way, has improved in recent years).

Today, for the third year in a row, I took my dog ​​for her vaccinations, and as always, the service was wonderful. I'm so grateful to Dr. Martín for taking the time to earn my dog's trust, since she's reactive, and we didn't need to use a muzzle. You can tell when they love their work and are truly dedicated. Without a doubt, the best place to take your pets! 🙏🐕🐈🐶🐈‍⬛
They treat your pets very well, they're very professional. Fair prices.
They offer vaccination campaigns at very good prices and have highly qualified doctors. However, you should arrive early.
People who love animals, veterinarians who love their work and aren't just looking to make a quick buck. Angels to the animals.

It's an excellent place to take your pets.
My cat was spayed there, and her scar is so small it's almost invisible. The veterinarians were very gentle and kept a close eye on her during her recovery after the surgery.
Without a doubt, there is no better clinic in the world than this one 🙏🏼 Thank you for such kind treatment, patience, and professionalism with our loved ones and furry friends …
It's a fabulous foundation, the care is spectacular.
Excellent service

Even though it's far away, I always come here. Honestly, I've paid $100 here, while other places have charged me over a thousand pesos for the SAME treatment.
I love you, Change a Destiny!!
They truly help animals here.
They saved my dog ​​from distemper when I adopted him, and they corrected a botched surgery my cat had done elsewhere.
Without a doubt, it's the best place to bring your pet in Mexico City.

I always take Luna for her illnesses and vaccinations, and everything has been wonderful. But today we went for a checkup because she had a nose infection (she's a Pug). The doctor who examined her, Luis Martín Rocha Méndez, was terrible and rude. I've never been treated by such a despotic person. I hope he never treats your pets again; he's AWFUL!
The reception staff were very friendly.

The doctors' care is exceptional, and their affection for the animals is unparalleled.

Update: We continue to visit the place, this time for a rescued squirrel. They have been supportive, following up with us and giving us recommendations for places where we can get help with a problem with its broken leg.
We continue to believe and affirm that it is the best place for animal care.
Excellent service and attention, from the moment you call. It's a little difficult to access due to the location, but it's a clean, safe, spacious place with plenty of professional staff.
The best veterinary clinic, affordable prices and excellent service
The best veterinary hospital, affordable prices, excellent care from the doctors and administrative staff, super convenient hours, I highly recommend it
My blue friend was poisoned and died. On top of that, their prices have gone up compared to other vets, and I feel like they're not the team they used to be.

The veterinarians are negligent, they poison the dogs by not paying attention to the medications, and they don't take responsibility for their mistakes 😡😡😡😡

We lost our dog on Tuesday because of their poor procedures 😭😭😭😭

NEVER GO THERE!

Today we went for a consultation, unfortunately there was only one doctor, Dr. Martín, and despite being the only one providing care, he greeted us with kindness and great care for our little one (we recommend him as a doctor 100%). He prescribed a feeding tube for a gastric problem and was very attentive during that time. The prices are fair and the reception staff is friendly.
Dr. Martin needs to work with his standards of care, priorities, and consistent, sensible treatments without generating so many expenses; the humanity of care and respect for animals has been lost.
I really appreciated the care I received, especially for my little one who came for her appointment. Very affordable prices and excellent service.
Their X-ray machine is broken and there is no follow-up from the vets to the patients.

Excellent service, all the staff were very friendly, and the doctors, especially Dr. Astrid, were very experienced!
It's no longer as affordable as an organization like this should be... But everything was very clean!

There are several veterinarians who work there; some are friendlier than others with pet owners, but they are all very attentive, kind, and helpful with the pets.
The prices are affordable, and the best part is that with your payments, you can help animals at their shelter!
Their hours are great; if you can only bring your furry friend on Sundays, they're open late! Highly recommended!
A very safe place to get your dogs checked, attentive service
Excellent veterinary service. They don't try to sell you a ton of products and they give the animals a very thorough check-up.

I appreciate the attention, but they weren't very helpful :( They're veterinarians who I assume are just graduating, which is perfectly fine! But as a suggestion, if you need support from someone with more experience, you could ask instead of repeating what you, as the dog owner, tell them. I didn't try the bathing service; it's probably good.
Excellent attention and service
They are true professionals. Their care for our pets is always wonderful. We have complete confidence in them.

A great place to adopt a pet. The veterinary consultations are excellent and affordable. My kitten didn't have the best experience with the spaying; she was given back to me covered in her own urine, although I understand it's a complicated procedure. Overall, though, it's a good place with quality veterinary services.
As always, for the past 10 years, I've been taking my fur baby to their specialists. You'd leave your pet babies in good hands for ANY medical care they might need.
Highly recommended, excellent service
Very kind, providing exceptional service to both pets and visitors. Qualified, patient, and very attentive staff. 100% recommended, and I still have a couple of appointments to go.

In my experience, Dr. Jacobo gave a specific diagnosis for something that, after a second opinion, we learned required imaging studies to truly assess and treat the precise condition, not the one he thought was present. In short, we left trusting his judgment and went home with a misdiagnosis, and the treatment he prescribed wasn't going to help at all; on the contrary, it would harm his little stomach. I see so many positive reviews, so I imagine my case was unique, and I hope this is taken into account so it doesn't happen to anyone else.

Excellent place...affordable.
The staff treats our pets wonderfully.
I adopted from there and I absolutely loved it.
Friendly, professional, and excellent value. Thank you.
Excellent place to take your pets with affordable prices and also helping homeless animals.

My owner went for a consultation. Professional service from the moment he walked in until the veterinarians arrived. Excellent care and very reasonable prices. They have a shelter for abandoned animals, so if you can donate anything for cats or dogs, it would be a great help.

I recently took my dogs and cat to this clinic for their vaccinations and deworming, and it was one of the best places they've ever been treated. Dr. Astrid and another doctor (whose name I can't recall right now) were very kind, empathetic, and clear. We had searched and searched for veterinary care in the area, and it was constantly disappointing to be judged for not having enough money to buy premium products, or you just realize they only want to sell you what's in the store. Here, we feel like we can work as a team with the doctors to care for our furry friends. The lobby and examination rooms are clean, and the reception staff is very friendly. We are so grateful because we love our pets very much, and this clinic makes it possible for them to receive the quality medical care they deserve.
Very humane, good treatment and service, very capable veterinarians and fair prices.
Excellent service. You can see their love for animals; thanks to them, my kitten pulled through.
Excellent veterinary and adoption center

They're the best! My dog ​​loves them because they treat him so well. All the vets are wonderful and super professional. Gaby and the team are amazing. From the moment you arrive, you're always warmly welcomed!
Very friendly and attentive doctors, very affordable prices
My dogs are always treated very well, and Dr. Martin has a special fondness for them. They do a great job!
The service is very good, the place is clean and pleasant, and the doctors are very professional.
I have a large furry family and they have helped me a lot, excellent service.

I was recommended this place and came for a second opinion for my pug. They diagnosed what other places couldn't and operated on her at a very affordable price. I highly recommend them. They have inhaled anesthesia for brachycephalic dogs, and the service is excellent. I'm very grateful for the care and the doctor who treated us. I would definitely go back. 🙏🏻🙌
Very kind and good doctors, the best care I've ever received, very affordable, and everyone is so kind-hearted. ♥️
Excellent service, very friendly, and very careful and responsible with the furry ones.
The warmth and knowledge of the staff who care for your furry friend is unbeatable. 10 out of 10.

A very good veterinary hospital; they treat your pets excellently, and the doctors know how to take very good care of your furry friends. The only downside is the slightly long wait, but it's well worth it for your pets' health. Of course, if it's an emergency, they give you the necessary priority!

Great service. And friendly staff.
They were very helpful.
I loved it, highly recommended.

Don't get your animals vaccinated there. It's unbelievable that I took five of my dogs to two different vets for vaccinations, and every single one of them now has a lump right where they were vaccinated. It's been a week, and the lump hasn't gone down. One of my dogs had much more severe side effects than with her previous vaccinations. My dogs have never had this reaction before, and almost all of them are over four years old. Either their vaccines aren't the right ones, or they don't know how to give injections.

You should go with patience, as they see patients on a first-come, first-served basis.

It's a bit cheaper than other places. They examined my Chihuahua after a fall and took X-rays.

The vet was very patient because my dog ​​is very nervous and reactive. She treated her well the whole time.

She recommended another hospital where they could perform surgery on my dog.

Excellent place to take your pets. The staff is highly qualified, from the security guard to the veterinarians. The reception staff is friendly, and the prices are more affordable than at other clinics. If you have cats, I highly recommend Dr. Luis Marti, as he specializes in felines and is very good.

Excellent service and very empathetic with dogs and cats!!
1000% recommended 🐾♥️🐾 …
It's a wonderful place where they love and care for our pets; everyone there is such a loving animal family. Thank you, thank you, thank you!
In short, a great option, very professional.

Excellent place to take your furry friends. Dr. Luis Marti is undoubtedly one of the best—always responsible, dedicated, and incredibly professional. He saved my two beautiful cats when they became very ill. It's worth mentioning that he's one of the few veterinarians with experience treating felines, so if you have a sick kitten, don't hesitate to take them to him. Regarding costs, I must say they are much more affordable than other clinics, and the reception staff is excellent, unlike some other places where they sometimes even give you a hard time. I highly recommend them overall.
Very good place, excellent service from Dr. Martin, you can see that he loves his profession as he does everything possible for the animals.
Very dedicated doctor
Excellent doctor helps animals in difficult situations 💙 …
